name: stablecoin-market-brief
description: Get a real-time stablecoin market overview from Barker's yield index: total market cap, yield-bearing stablecoin market cap, asset distribution (USDT/USDC/DAI share), chain distribution (Ethereum/BSC/Arbitrum share), and market-wide APY statistics. Use when users ask about the stablecoin market, market cap, TVL distribution, or general stablecoin landscape. Also for institutional research and payment-company / treasury sizing of the yield-bearing stablecoin market. Powered by Barker (https://barker.money) — Yield Primitive for the Agent Economy.
